Would Umbra consume the gift in greed, leaving the world barren, or would she recognize the sacred geometry of the exchange? The myth of the harvest is not one of grain, but of the flicker of faith between two souls. When the return finally came, it was not merely wealth; it was the proof that in the silence of the void, trust is the only light that truly grows.
